name: Zenitan
reason: zenitan.com does not resolve at all (DNS failure), and WebSearch found no trace of a real business called 'Zenitan' under this or any other domain in the Gulf.

name: andalusia-dentalcenters
reason: Andalusia is a Jeddah hospital group (hospital plus dental, women's health and children's health centers/clinics). Healthcare clinics/hospitals are explicitly excluded under gate 2 (only retail pharmacy chains pass, and this is not a pharmacy).

name: aldo
reason: ALDO KSA is operated under franchise by Cenomi Retail (formerly Alhokair Fashion Retail / Fawaz Alhokair & Co), a Saudi conglomerate genuinely HQ'd in Riyadh and listed on the Tadawul exchange -- this matches the rule's own example of a Saudi conglomerate holding local franchise rights, so gate 1 passes. Fashion/footwear/handbags is an approved, multi-item, repeat-purchase category, and the storefront is a fully live transactional e-commerce site with a large catalog. || CROSS-VERIFICATION (independent 2nd pass): Gate 6: ALDO is a global fashion/footwear brand franchise-operated in KSA (Cenomi historically, franchise rights sold to Abdullah Al-Othaim Fashion in May 2024), exactly the enumerated global-brand-storefront pattern that folds into the covered operator rather than standing as its own account. The reason's Cenomi attribution is also stale.

name: cb2
reason: CB2 in Saudi Arabia is operated under franchise by Majid Al Futtaim Lifestyle, which is HQ'd in Dubai, UAE. Per gate 1, a store run by a UAE-HQ'd group fails even with genuine, substantial local stores.

name: ezorder
reason: EZOrder is a B2B office-supplies and Managed Print Services distributor serving corporate/office clients via SAP/Oracle Punchout (cXML/SAP Ariba) procurement integration, not a consumer retail storefront. This matches the explicitly excluded wholesale/trading/distribution (B2B) category.

name: tejaradirect
reason: Tejaradirect is a B2B industrial/electrical/construction-machinery distributor (generators, pumps, circuit breakers, industrial connectors, construction wiring devices, forklifts, excavators). This matches multiple explicitly excluded categories: wholesale/trading/distribution (B2B), and construction/electrical-wiring-for-construction.

name: almaraipro
reason: Almarai is a large-scale Saudi dairy/juice/bakery/poultry manufacturer that distributes through 220,000+ third-party points of sale; the site is a corporate/brand site with no consumer e-commerce cart. This matches the explicitly excluded manufacturing/industrial category (confirms prior verdict).

name: gehealthcare
reason: GE HealthCare is a global medical-imaging/equipment manufacturer headquartered in the United States; gehealthcare.sa is simply its Saudi-localized corporate domain, not an independently Saudi-HQ'd entity, and the business is medical-equipment manufacturing, not retail.

name: investsaudi
reason: Invest Saudi is the Ministry of Investment of Saudi Arabia's FDI-promotion site -- a government body, not a retail business of any kind.

name: hilti
reason: Hilti is a global power-tools/construction-equipment manufacturer headquartered in Liechtenstein; hilti.sa is its own Saudi B2B sales portal for construction professionals and contractors, not an independent Saudi-HQ'd retailer. The business (professional construction tools/chemical anchors/firestop systems) would also fail gate 2 as construction/industrial equipment.

name: thebowerycompany
reason: The Bowery Company was founded and remains HQ'd in the UAE; its Saudi showroom/e-commerce presence is a market expansion of the UAE-HQ'd group, which fails gate 1 regardless of the genuine Riyadh showroom and real e-commerce site.

name: aldahan
reason: Aldahan is a building-materials retailer/contracting supplier (شركة أبناء حسن حسن الدهان -- 'Al-Dahan Store for Building Materials') based in Al-Qatif, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. Building materials/construction/contracting is explicitly excluded under gate 2.

name: jadco-sa
reason: JAD Portal Company (JADTECH) is a B2B digital-transformation and software consultancy (a JAD-B2B platform for the agriculture/water sector, plus a JAD-ERP resource-planning product), not a retail business. Matches the explicitly excluded B2B services/agencies category.

name: visitsaudi
reason: Visit Saudi is the official Saudi Tourism Authority destination-marketing site. Travel/tourism/hospitality is explicitly excluded under gate 2, and it is a government body rather than a retail business.

name: peaberry
reason: Peaberry is a genuine small Jeddah specialty-coffee cafe/roastery (Saudi HQ'd; F&B/coffee would pass category and repeat-purchase gates) built on a real Salla e-commerce platform, but the storefront currently has no live purchasable products -- every product URL listed in its own sitemap returns HTTP 410 Gone, so there is no confirmed, currently-operating transactional catalog.

name: almutawir
reason: Al Mutawir (الأبداع المطور) is a B2B point-of-sale/accounting/ERP SaaS product (ZATCA e-invoicing compliance) sold to shops, restaurants, cafes and billiard halls -- it is a software vendor, not a retail storefront itself, matching the excluded B2B services/software category.

name: repairlabsa
reason: Business is fundamentally a single-location phone/device repair and maintenance shop in Khobar, not a retail store; the accessories/used-phone e-commerce is explicitly framed as an add-on. Does not fit any of the 4 approved retail categories as its primary nature.

name: vw
reason: Volkswagen Saudi Arabia official site is an automotive manufacturer/dealer site (models, configurator, dealer/service-center locator, brochures) -- automotive dealers/distributors are an explicit hard-fail category regardless of ownership structure.

name: schindler
reason: Local operating entity (Schindler Olayan Elevator Co. Ltd, a genuine Saudi joint venture with Olayan Group, HQ disclosed as Jeddah) passes Gate 1, but the business itself is an elevator/escalator manufacturer and modernization/maintenance provider -- squarely the excluded manufacturing/industrial (and construction-adjacent capital equipment) category, not retail.

name: interflow
category: B2B restaurant POS / digital-menu SaaS (software vendor, not a retailer)
reason: Interflow sells cashier/POS and digital-menu software to restaurants and cafes -- it is a B2B software vendor, not itself a fashion/beauty/grocery/electronics retailer. Explicit Gate-2 B2B-services exclusion applies.

name: pfizerpro
category: pharmaceutical manufacturer HCP professional portal (not retail)
reason: PfizerPro is Pfizer's login-gated professional/medical-information portal for healthcare professionals in Saudi Arabia -- a pharmaceutical manufacturer's corporate site with zero consumer commerce, not a retail pharmacy. Does not match any approved retail category.

name: oryx
category: automotive/scooter distributor (Arabian Auto Agency Co. Ltd)
reason: oryx.sa is suspended, but the business has moved to oryx.com.sa, which shows it is Arabian Auto Agency Co. Ltd's ORYX scooter/vehicle distribution business -- an automotive distributor, hard-excluded regardless of the fact it is genuinely Saudi-HQ'd (Jeddah).

name: abrtrd
reason: Domain resolves but hosts nothing except a bare LiteSpeed 'Index of /' directory listing with zero files -- functionally no website. A WebSearch for the business turned up several different, unrelated 'ABR' trading/contracting companies in Saudi Arabia/UAE, none confirmably tied to this exact domain, so no live alternative site could be confirmed.

name: alromaihgroup
reason: Al-Romaih Group's site is a diversified holding-company corporate portfolio page (paints manufacturing, hotels, chemicals, real estate, poultry, steel, oilfield chemicals, IT, fintech) -- not a retail storefront in any approved category, and has no cart/checkout of its own.
